page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 8 physical Intel Xeon 8475B cores, running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and 1:2 CPU-to-memory ratio make this instance suitable for compute-bound workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, front-end web servers, and moderate computational tasks that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage.
